crm.aciklama: Requests from the website, price quotes and embedded forms are collected here as leads. A new request from the same email is added to the open lead's timeline.
crm.iceAktarOnay: Add every past request and price quote that is not in the CRM yet as a lead? Pressing again does not create duplicates.
crm.iceAktarildi: {{olusturulan}} new leads created, {{eklenen}} requests added to existing leads.
crm.surukleIpucu: Drag a card onto another stage, or use the “Move” selector on the card.
crm.mevcutAday: An open lead with this email already exists.
crm.silOnay: Delete “{{ad}}”? The lead and its activities move to the trash and can be restored from there.
crm.aktiviteOrnek: What was discussed, what was agreed?
crm.donusturOnay: Send a client panel invitation to {{eposta}} and mark the lead as “Won”?
crm.donusturEpostaGerekli: The lead needs an email address to be converted to a client.
crm.davetElle: The invitation email could not be sent; you can copy the text below and send it yourself.

davetDurumu.skipped: Invitation email skipped (email service is not set up).
davetDurumu.failed: Invitation email could not be sent.
davetDurumu.off: Email channel is off; no invitation was sent.

puan.dipnot: The score is calculated only from these five rules and is recalculated as the lead changes.

deger.butceVar: a budget or estimated value is given
deger.etkilesim: {{sayi}} interactions (note, call, email, meeting, new request) × 5

ozet.huniAciklama: Leads that reached each stage and the share that moved on to the next one.
ozet.sureYok: No lead has changed stage yet.

asamaYonetimi.aciklama: Order the pipeline stages, rename them (7 languages), set colour, type and default probability.
asamaYonetimi.tasimaGerekli: This stage has {{sayi}} leads; choose where to move them before deleting:
asamaYonetimi.hedef: Stage to move the leads to
asamaYonetimi.kural: At least one stage of each type (open, won, lost) must remain. If a form's default stage is deleted, the first open stage is used.

form.aciklama: Lead forms to paste into your own site or your clients' sites. Submissions become leads with the “Embedded form” source. There is no consent checkbox: a privacy notice line and link appear below the send button; if you want marketing permission, it is asked separately and optionally.
form.aktifEt: Form is live (a disabled form accepts no submissions)
form.kopyalanamadi: Could not copy; select the code manually.
form.onizlemeUyari: A submission from the preview creates a real lead.
form.silOnay: Delete form “{{ad}}”? It stops working on the sites where it is embedded; it can be restored from the trash.
form.epostaKilitli: Email is always shown and required: submissions from the same person are grouped into one lead by it.
form.tesekkurIpucu: If left empty, a ready-made text is shown in the visitor's language.
form.izinliIpucu: Subdomains are allowed too. Always allowed: {{liste}}
form.kvkkSurumIpucu: Current version: {{sayi}}. Changing the line or the link raises the version; every submission is stored with the version it saw.
form.aydinlatmaMetniIpucu: Leave empty to show a ready-made sentence in the visitor's language.
form.aydinlatmaAciklama: Shown below the send button together with the privacy notice link, as information only; no consent is requested.
form.pazarlamaSorIpucu: The form shows an unticked “I would like to hear about campaigns and announcements by email” box. If ticked, the permission, its time and the text version are recorded; the form is sent either way.

hata.aday_yok: Lead not found (it may have been deleted).
hata.alan_uzun: The “{{alan}}” field is too long (at most {{en_cok}} characters).
hata.eposta_gecersiz: Please enter a valid email address.
hata.etiket_uzun: Tags can be at most 40 characters.
hata.etiket_sayisi: At most 20 tags can be added.
hata.ayni_eposta_acik_aday: An open lead with this email already exists.
hata.eposta_yok: The lead has no valid email address.
hata.kazanildi_asamasi_yok: There is no stage of type “Won”.
hata.asama_sayisi: There can be at most 20 stages.
hata.sira_gecersiz: The order list must contain every stage.
hata.son_tur_asamasi: The last stage of this type cannot be deleted or have its type changed.
hata.tasima_gerekli: This stage has {{sayi}} leads; choose where to move them first.
hata.hedef_gecersiz: Leads cannot be moved to the stage being deleted.
hata.alanlar_gecersiz: Field settings could not be read.
hata.alan_adi_sayisi: At most 20 domains can be added.
hata.yonlendirme_https: The redirect address must start with https://.
hata.aydinlatma_https: The privacy notice link must start with https://.
hata.tesekkur_uzun: The thank-you text is too long.
hata.kvkk_metni_gerekli: The consent text is required (at least 10 characters).
hata.kvkk_metni_uzun: The consent text is too long.
hata.aydinlatma_metni_uzun: The privacy notice line is too long (600 characters at most).

pazarlama.geriAlOnay: Withdraw the marketing permission? Use this when the person has told you they opted out; it cannot be given again from the panel, only by the person ticking the box in a form again.
